page.overview:
Who is Malcolm Mayweather?

Malcolm Mayweather is a character created by Canadian author Troy Young for his Nyarlathotep Cycle series of Cthulhu Mythos stories.

Mayweather is a tall, physically fit black Canadian man, likely in his late twenties or early thirties. Since a violent encounter with a magic-using Nyarlathotep cultist, he is missing his left arm. He is capable of utilising minor magic, but the effects of this appear to consist solely of the ability to keep away the effects of the nightmares caused by exposure to the entities of the Cthulhu Mythos.

Mayweather was exposed to radiation in a temple to Nyarlathotep which caused him to develop a highly-aggressive form of cancer. It has been speculated that this is a magical affliction, which Nyarlathotep is capable of accelerating, halting, and perhaps even reversing.

A relationship had begun to form between Mayweather and junior agent Charlene Hines; this was cut short with the death of both parties.
